purpose: Canonical controlled vocabulary for runtime-emitted enum-shaped strings: ExecutionDecision.reason_code, ExceptionLakeAdmissionRecord.admission_reason_code, DefectRecord.defect_class, and the semantic-mutation action deny-list consulted by the orchestrator's execution_authority.
authority_rule: Runtime repos (orchestrator, exceptions-lake-runtime, legal-knowledge-runtime, skills-registry) MUST NOT invent values for these fields. They consume from this registry via generated/loaded constants and emit only registered values.
non_claims: this registry does not authorize runtime actions
this registry does not change object schemas at runtime
this registry is content-addressed via the contract surface; modifying it forces a consumer lock refresh

validator_contract.scan_rule: AST scan of each runtime repo's src/ tree. Any kwarg-style string literal at reason_code=, admission_reason_code=, defect_class= must be a member of the corresponding vocabulary. The deny-list runtime.semantic_mutation_actions is asserted by tests that read the runtime constants module and compare to this registry.
